findings.message: Rust reconstructed the closed five-case full-network energy certificate from the fixed topology and complete envelope
passive network certificate is valid; comparator hysteresis, common-mode/input-capacitance conditions, MAX31865 force-path idealization, and brownout hardware applicability remain unqualified
unit host connector source component is absent from native board
unit_io pad 1 is not connected to authored source net +3V3
unit_io pad 2 is not connected to authored source net GND
unit_io pad 3 is not connected to authored source net GND
unit_io pad 4 is not connected to authored source net RTD_SCK
unit_io pad 5 is not connected to authored source net RTD_SDI
unit_io pad 6 is not connected to authored source net RTD_SDO
unit_io pad 7 is not connected to authored source net RTD_CS_N
unit_io pad 8 is not connected to authored source net RTD_DRDY
unit_io pad 9 is not connected to authored source net RTD_HW_FAULT
unit_io pad 10 is not connected to authored source net SHARED_REF_2V5
unit_io connector MPN and source pin map are pending qualification
source-derived local load 8.448898 mA and reference boundary 100.000 uA/10.000 nF are within contract
RTD_DRDY uses GPIO 65535; GPIO 9 is source-defined
RTD_DRDY lacks the source-derived GPIO/ADC pin/series resistor binding
unit_io.4 has no RTD_SCK source connection
unit_io.5 has no RTD_SDI source connection
unit_io.6 has no RTD_SDO source connection
unit_io.7 has no RTD_CS_N source connection
unit_io.8 has no RTD_DRDY source connection
TPS389001 threshold/NAND ownership and powered-comparator static truth are observed
static rail detector is proven, but guaranteed worst-case brownout timing was not physically measured
standalone RTD unit has no external HV/domain boundary population; cooker crossings are out of scope
